name: Hahn

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story primary residence with a dark gray roof and skylights located toward the rear of a long narrow lot|A detached white structure with a gray roof sits near the front of the property|A smaller white structure with an orange roof is positioned in the middle of the yard|A long dirt driveway runs along one side of the lot from the street to the rear|Large open grassy areas fill the spaces around the structures|Wooden fencing encloses the entire property.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows a long dirt driveway leading back from the street|A detached white structure with a gray roof is located near the front fence|The primary white house with a dark gray roof and covered porch sits farther back on the lot|Wooden fencing runs along both sides|Trash bins are positioned near the front fence line.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the long side of the white house with a dark gray roof|A long dirt driveway runs parallel to the house along the property line|Open grassy areas extend between the house and the front of the lot|A smaller white structure with an orange roof and a detached white building are visible toward the front|Wooden fencing encloses the perimeter.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the white house with a dark gray roof and skylights|A  patio area faces the rear|Grass and a couple of garden beds extends behind the house to the back fence|Wooden fencing encloses the rear of the property|The long dirt driveway is visible along one side.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the white house and the long dirt driveway running the length of the lot|A detached white structure sits near the front, and a smaller white structure with an orange roof is located in the middle of the yard|Wooden fencing and a gate are visible near the front|Open grassy areas fill the lot between the structures.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long dirt driveway that runs the full length of the narrow lot from the street toward the rear. The primary house sits toward the back of the property, with a detached white structure near the front and a smaller structure in the middle yard. Large open grassy areas provide clear space around the buildings. Wooden fencing fully encloses the lot, with a gate near the front. No vehicles are visible on the property in the current imagery. The lot is long and narrow with neighboring residences on both sides.
clarifications: Does the long dirt driveway allow vehicle access all the way to the rear of the house, or does it become too narrow or soft for larger vehicles? What is the primary use of the detached white structure near the front of the lot? Is the smaller orange-roofed structure a storage shed, greenhouse, or other use? Is the front gate locked or restricted? Can personnel move freely around both sides of the house given the fencing and neighboring properties?
